messages.subject: Error in multi group analysis
parts:
Dear Yves and lavaan users, 

I have a non-recursive model as indicated below. 

model <- '
flex ~ LNVehpL + flexavailable  + gendM   + eduNoCol + eduundgrad 
LNVehpL ~ flex  + Accessibility.R  +inc100l + inc100t150 + inc150t250 +
eduNoCol + eduundgrad + child + resown + gendM + wmodeBike + wmodeBus + wmodeRail + wmodeWalk + age + LNmiles
'

A "non-group" analysis solves normally and gives me expected results
fit <- sem(model, data = subset(data), ordered = c("flex"))

However, when I want to undertake a multi group analysis by adding group = "subclass"  , I get the following error
Error in if (abs(rho.init) >= 1) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Any suggestions? I did not find any previous posts with similar errors. I have also attacked my dataset. 

Thanks for your time

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error in multi group analysis
parts:
> However, when I want to undertake a multi group analysis by adding group
> = "subclass" , I get the following error
> Error in if (abs(rho.init) >= 1) { :
> missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
>
> Any suggestions? I did not find any previous posts with similar errors.
> I have also attacked my dataset.

Thanks for attaching your dataset. It turns out that this is triggered
by a colinearity issue in group 4.

You can already see it if you just run:

fit <- lm(LNVehpL ~ wmodeBike + wmodeBus + wmodeRail + wmodeWalk, data =
subset(data, subclass == 4))

coef(fit)

(Intercept) wmodeBike wmodeBus wmodeRail wmodeWalk
0.27137792 0.09359312 0.03373057 -0.01141247 NA

Removing one of these 'wmode' variables will solve the problem.

Yves.
